candidate.title: Loki now enforces a max label limit of 15 labels per series, down from 30
candidate.text: Loki now enforces a max label limit of 15 labels per series, down from 30. Extra labels inflate the size of the index and reduce performance, you should almost never need more than 15 labels. Refer to Changes to default configure values.

evidence.excerpt: * Loki now enforces a max label limit of 15 labels per series, down from 30.
